CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_available_products_mcpn()

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_messages_mcpn(p_group text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 60, p_send_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_detalhes jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_edit_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_delete_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, uid_emissor uuid, mensagem text, data_registrada timestamp with time zone, detalhes jsonb, telefone text, nome_exibicao text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_new_id bigint;
  v_affected integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'
      USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  IF p_group IS DISTINCT FROM 'community' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid group'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_delete_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.chat_gruop
    WHERE id = p_delete_id
      AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_affected = ROW_COUNT;
    IF v_affected = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Message not found or access denied'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_edit_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.chat_gruop
      SET mensagem = p_send_message,
          detalhes = COALESCE(p_detalhes, detalhes)
      WHERE id = p_edit_id
        AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;
    ELSIF p_detalhes IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.chat_gruop
      SET detalhes = p_detalhes
      WHERE id = p_edit_id
        AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;
    END IF;

    IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL OR p_detalhes IS NOT NULL THEN
      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_affected = ROW_COUNT;
      IF v_affected = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Message not found or access denied'
          USING ERRCODE = '42501';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.uid_emissor,
      c.mensagem,
      c.data_registrada,
      c.detalhes,
      COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
      COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
    FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
    WHERE c.id = p_edit_id;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF (p_send_message IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(p_send_message)) > 0)
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'imagem_url', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'arquivo_url', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'audio_path', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  THEN
    INSERT INTO public.chat_gruop (
      uid_emissor,
      mensagem,
      detalhes,
      data_registrada
    )
    VALUES (
      v_user_id,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_send_message), ''), ''),
      COALESCE(p_detalhes, '{}'::jsonb),
      now()
    )
    RETURNING chat_gruop.id INTO v_new_id;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.uid_emissor,
      c.mensagem,
      c.data_registrada,
      c.detalhes,
      COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
      COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
    FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
    WHERE c.id = v_new_id;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.uid_emissor,
    c.mensagem,
    c.data_registrada,
    c.detalhes,
    COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
    COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
  FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
  LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
  ORDER BY c.data_registrada DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_messages_mcpn(p_user1 uuid, p_user2 uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 150, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_mark_as_read boolean DEFAULT true, p_send_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_detalhes jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, remetente_id uuid, destinatario_id uuid, mensagem text, detalhes jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_current_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_sender uuid;
  v_recipient uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p_send_message)) > 0 THEN
    v_sender := COALESCE(v_current_user, p_user1);
    v_recipient := CASE WHEN p_user1 = v_sender THEN p_user2 ELSE p_user1 END;
    
    RETURN QUERY
    INSERT INTO public.sys_t110 (remetente_id, destinatario_id, mensagem, detalhes, created_at)
    VALUES (
      v_sender,
      v_recipient,
      p_send_message,
      COALESCE(p_detalhes, '{"lida": false}'::jsonb),
      now()
    )
    RETURNING sys_t110.id, sys_t110.remetente_id, sys_t110.destinatario_id, sys_t110.mensagem, sys_t110.detalhes, sys_t110.created_at;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_mark_as_read AND v_current_user IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.sys_t110
    SET detalhes = COALESCE(detalhes, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"lida": true}'::jsonb
    WHERE destinatario_id = v_current_user
      AND remetente_id = CASE WHEN p_user1 = v_current_user THEN p_user2 ELSE p_user1 END
      AND (detalhes->>'lida' IS NULL OR detalhes->>'lida' = 'false');
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT t.id, t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id, t.mensagem, t.detalhes, t.created_at
  FROM public.sys_t110 t
  WHERE
    (LEAST(t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id) = LEAST(p_user1, p_user2))
    AND
    (GREATEST(t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id) = GREATEST(p_user1, p_user2))
  ORDER BY t.created_at ASC
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_collection_bank_details_mcpn(p_bank_id uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_general_history_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, type text, amount numeric, description text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sessão expirada';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    -- Recargas
    SELECT
        p.id::text,
        'recarga'::text          AS type,
        p.valor                  AS amount,
        'Recarga via ' || COALESCE(p.metodo_pagamento, 'transferência')  AS description,
        p.status,
        p.created_at
    FROM public.paymentbot p
    WHERE p.user_id = v_uid

    UNION ALL

    -- Saques/Retiradas
    SELECT
        r.id::text,
        'saque'::text            AS type,
        r.valor                  AS amount,
        'Saque solicitado'::text AS description,
        r.status,
        r.created_at
    FROM public.retiradas_mcpn r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_uid

    UNION ALL

    -- Extrato unificado (renda_diaria + comissao_equipe)
    SELECT
        e.id::text,
        e.tipo                   AS type,
        e.valor                  AS amount,
        CASE e.tipo
            WHEN 'renda_diaria'    THEN 'Rendimento diário do robô'
            WHEN 'comissao_equipe' THEN 'Comissão de equipa (Nível ' || COALESCE(e.nivel::text, '?') || ')'
            ELSE e.tipo
        END                      AS description,
        'confirmed'::text        AS status,
        e.created_at
    FROM public.extrato_mcpn e
    WHERE e.user_id = v_uid

    ORDER BY created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_account_data()
 RETURNS TABLE(saldo_disponivel numeric, total_recarregado numeric, total_retirado numeric, total_comissao_equipe numeric, lucro_acumulado numeric, tarefas_hoje integer, telefone text, nome_exibicao text, codigo_meu_refferal text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    a.saldo_disponivel::numeric,
    a.total_recarregado::numeric,
    a.total_retirado::numeric,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(valor) FROM public.bonus_equipe_mcpn WHERE user_id = a.id), 0)::numeric,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(valor) FROM public.renda_diaria_mcpn WHERE user_id = a.id), 0)::numeric,
    COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM public.renda_diaria_mcpn WHERE user_id = a.id AND created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE), 0)::integer,
    a.telefone::text,
    a.nome_exibicao::text,
    a.codigo_meu_refferal::text
  FROM public.nucleo a
  WHERE a.id = v_user_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_bank_accounts_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, bank_name text, owner_name text, iban text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        t.id                                                                                   AS id,
        (t.dados_bancarios->>'nome_banco')::text                                               AS bank_name,
        COALESCE(private_mcpn.decrypt_data_mcpn(t.dados_bancarios->>'nome_completo'), 'Titular')::text AS owner_name,
        COALESCE(private_mcpn.decrypt_data_mcpn(t.dados_bancarios->>'iban'), '')::text         AS iban,
        t.updated_at
    FROM public.nucleo t
    WHERE t.id = v_user_id
      AND t.dados_bancarios IS NOT NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_purchased_products_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, preco_pago numeric, renda_diaria numeric, data_inicio timestamp with time zone, data_fim timestamp with time zone, dias_restantes integer, ativo boolean, produto_nome text, produto_imagem text, url_download_setup text, storage_size text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        up.id, 
        up.preco_pago, 
        up.renda_diaria,
        up.data_inicio, 
        up.data_fim, 
        GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(DAY FROM (up.data_fim - now()))::integer) as dias_restantes,
        CASE WHEN up.data_fim <= now() THEN false ELSE up.ativo END as ativo,
        COALESCE(p.nome, 'Robô de Renda')::text as produto_nome,
        ''::text as produto_imagem,
        ''::text as url_download_setup,
        'Cloud'::text as storage_size
    FROM public.sys_600 up
    LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON up.produto_id = p.id
    WHERE up.user_id = auth.uid()
    ORDER BY up.data_inicio DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_recharges_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, valor numeric, banco_origem text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, chave_transacao text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        r.id,
        r.valor,
        COALESCE(
            r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_origem',
            r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_destino',
            r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco',
            'Depósito Bancário'
        )::text AS banco_origem,
        r.status::text,
        r.created_at,
        COALESCE(r.detalhes_transacao->>'chave_transacao', '')::text AS chave_transacao
    FROM public.paymentbot r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id
    ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_recharges_summary_mcpn()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_total_aprovado NUMERIC := 0;
    v_total_pendente NUMERIC := 0;
    v_qtd_total INT := 0;
    v_qtd_aprovadas INT := 0;
    v_qtd_pendentes INT := 0;
    v_recharges JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso não autorizado: autenticação obrigatória.';
    END IF;

    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('aprovado', 'concluido', 'approved', 'completed') THEN r.valor ELSE 0 END), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('pendente', 'pending', 'recarregando') THEN r.valor ELSE 0 END), 0),
        COUNT(*),
        COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('aprovado', 'concluido', 'approved', 'completed')), 0),
        COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('pendente', 'pending', 'recarregando')), 0)
    INTO 
        v_total_aprovado,
        v_total_pendente,
        v_qtd_total,
        v_qtd_aprovadas,
        v_qtd_pendentes
    FROM public.paymentbot r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', r.id,
                'valor', r.valor,
                'amount', r.valor,
                'status', r.status,
                'created_at', r.created_at,
                'banco_origem', COALESCE(
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_origem',
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_destino',
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco',
                    'Depósito Bancário'
                ),
                'chave_transacao', COALESCE(r.detalhes_transacao->>'chave_transacao', ''),
                'comprovativo_url', COALESCE(r.detalhes_transacao->>'comprovativo_url', ''),
                'detalhes_transacao', r.detalhes_transacao
            ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ), '[]'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_recharges
    FROM public.paymentbot r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'total_aprovado', v_total_aprovado,
        'total_pendente', v_total_pendente,
        'qtd_total', v_qtd_total,
        'qtd_aprovadas', v_qtd_aprovadas,
        'qtd_pendentes', v_qtd_pendentes,
        'recharges', v_recharges
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_withdrawals_mcpn(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, banco_destino text, iban_snapshot text, valor_bruto numeric, valor_liquido numeric, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    w.id, 
    COALESCE(w.dados_bancarios_snapshot->>'banco', 'Banco não informado')::text AS banco_destino,
    COALESCE(w.dados_bancarios_snapshot->>'iban', 'Não informado')::text AS iban_snapshot,
    w.valor_bruto, 
    w.valor_liquido, 
    w.status::text, 
    w.created_at
  FROM public.retiradas_mcpn w
  WHERE w.user_id = v_user_id
  ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
END; 
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sender_phone_mcpn(p_uid uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_detailed boolean DEFAULT true, p_get_count boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rec record;
  v_count bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_get_count THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.nucleo;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('count', v_count);
  END IF;

  IF p_uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '{}'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  SELECT 
    a.id,
    a.telefone,
    COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao, a.telefone, 'Contato') AS nome_exibicao,
    a.avatar_url,
    a.bio,
    a.updated_at,
    e.created_at AS invited_at
  INTO v_rec
  FROM public.nucleo a
  LEFT JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e ON e.usuario_id = a.id
  WHERE a.id = p_uid
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_rec.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '{}'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_rec.id,
    'nome_exibicao', v_rec.nome_exibicao,
    'telefone', v_rec.telefone,
    'avatar_url', v_rec.avatar_url,
    'bio', v_rec.bio,
    'invited_at', v_rec.invited_at,
    'registered_at', v_rec.invited_at
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_withdraw_info_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(balance numeric, has_bank boolean, bank_name text, bank_id uuid, is_verified boolean, iban text, has_pending boolean, has_bots boolean, total_daily_income numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_user_id UUID := auth.uid(); BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT COALESCE((SELECT a.saldo_disponivel::numeric FROM public.nucleo a WHERE a.id = v_user_id LIMIT 1), 0::numeric) AS balance, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id) AS has_bank, (SELECT (b.dados_bancarios->>'nome_banco')::text FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS bank_name, (SELECT b.user_id FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS bank_id, true AS is_verified, (SELECT private_mcpn.decrypt_data_mcpn(b.dados_bancarios->>'iban')::text FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS iban, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.retiradas_mcpn r WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id AND r.status = 'pendente') AS has_pending, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sys_600 s WHERE s.user_id = v_user_id AND s.ativo = true AND (s.data_fim IS NULL OR s.data_fim > now())) AS has_bots, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.renda_diaria) FROM public.sys_600 s WHERE s.user_id = v_user_id AND s.ativo = true AND (s.data_fim IS NULL OR s.data_fim > now())), 0::numeric) AS total_daily_income; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_withdrawal_request(p_amount numeric, p_bank_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_password text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS json

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_my_profile_mcpn(p_nome_exibicao text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_avatar_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_bio text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Não autenticado');
      END IF;

      UPDATE public.nucleo
      SET 
        nome_exibicao = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_nome_exibicao), ''), nome_exibicao),
        avatar_url = COALESCE(p_avatar_url, avatar_url),
        bio = COALESCE(p_bio, bio),
        updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = v_uid;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'nome_exibicao', p_nome_exibicao,
        'avatar_url', p_avatar_url,
        'bio', p_bio
      );
    END;
    $function$
